blocks.text: During these eight days in Suriname you will witness its natural beauty, authenticity and cultural mix: the wooden colonial city of Paramaribo and its river dolphins, two days with the Maroon communities of the Upper Suriname River, the bird-rich wetlands of Bigi Pan, and the Jewish heritage of Jodensavanne with the Arawak village of Redi Doti, always guided in small groups.
